title: सोना महँगा हुआ, पर असली दौलत क्या है?
description: सोने-चाँदी के दाम आसमान पर हैं, पर असली दौलत क्या है? सेठ धनीराम और मोची रामू की यह कहानी जरूर देखिए। #moralstory #hindistory #gold #shorts
style_look: Warm golden hour moral storytelling illustration, simple stickman characters with round white heads and small black dot eyes, soft glowing amber sunlight, warm orange and gold palette, textured painterly background, clean bold outlines, square composition, no text, no letters, no watermark.

hook.line: सोना महँगा हुआ, पर असली दौलत?

gemini_style: warm, emotional Hindi storyteller with a steady medium pace

scenes.narration: दोस्तों, आज सोना आसमान छू रहा है, पर क्या सोना ही असली दौलत है?
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing pile of gold bars and coins on a table, a golden price arrow shooting up into a sunset sky, warm golden hour light, an Indian village in the background.

scenes.narration: एक गाँव में सेठ धनीराम के पास सोने के ढेर थे।
scenes.image_prompt: Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a round white head, small black dot eyes, thick black mustache, maroon kurta, white dhoti and a golden yellow turban, standing proudly in front of heaps of gold in his big house.

scenes.narration: वो दिन रात बस सोना गिनता, किसी से बात तक नहीं करता था।
scenes.image_prompt: Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a round white head, small black dot eyes, thick black mustache, maroon kurta, white dhoti and a golden yellow turban, sitting alone at night counting gold coins by a small oil lamp, a lonely empty room.

scenes.narration: उसी गाँव में गरीब मोची रामू रहता था।
scenes.image_prompt: Ramu, a thin stickman cobbler with a round white head, small black dot eyes, a kind smile, faded blue kurta and a simple white cap, sitting outside his tiny roadside shoe repair shop under a banyan tree in a village with mud houses.

scenes.narration: रामू जो कमाता, उसमें से भूखों को रोटी खिला देता था।
scenes.image_prompt: Ramu, a thin stickman cobbler with a round white head, small black dot eyes, a kind smile, faded blue kurta and a simple white cap, handing rotis to a group of hungry village children and an old man, warm golden hour light.

scenes.narration: एक रात गाँव में भयंकर बाढ़ आ गई।
scenes.image_prompt: A dark stormy night, a huge flood of muddy water rushing through a village of mud houses, heavy rain, dramatic clouds, a few golden lantern lights glowing in the dark.

scenes.narration: सेठ अपनी सोने की पेटी लेकर भागा, पर कीचड़ में फँस गया।
scenes.image_prompt: Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a round white head, small black dot eyes, thick black mustache, maroon kurta, white dhoti and a golden yellow turban, stuck knee-deep in thick mud, hugging a heavy golden treasure chest, scared face, flood water rising.

scenes.narration: उसने मदद के लिए चिल्लाया, पर किसी ने उसकी तरफ देखा तक नहीं।
scenes.image_prompt: Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a round white head, small black dot eyes, thick black mustache, maroon kurta and a golden yellow turban, shouting for help with raised hand in the flood, villagers in the distance turning their backs and walking away.

scenes.narration: तभी रामू नाव लेकर आया और बोला, सेठ जी, हाथ पकड़िए।
scenes.image_prompt: Ramu, a thin stickman cobbler with a round white head, small black dot eyes, a kind smile, faded blue kurta and a simple white cap, rowing a small wooden boat through the flood and stretching out his hand toward the merchant, a lantern glowing on the boat.

scenes.narration: सेठ ने पेटी छोड़कर रामू का हाथ थाम लिया।
scenes.image_prompt: Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a round white head, thick black mustache, maroon kurta and a golden yellow turban, letting go of the treasure chest and gripping Ramu's hand, Ramu, a thin stickman with a white cap and blue kurta, pulling him into the boat.

scenes.narration: सोना बाढ़ में बह गया, पर सेठ की जान बच गई।
scenes.image_prompt: The golden treasure chest floating away and sinking in the muddy flood water, in the foreground a small boat carrying a relieved Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman with a mustache and golden turban, and Ramu, a thin stickman with a white cap.

scenes.narration: सुबह सेठ ने रामू को गले लगाकर कहा, असली दौलत इंसानियत है।
scenes.image_prompt: Sunrise after the flood, Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a mustache and golden yellow turban, hugging Ramu, a thin stickman cobbler with a white cap and blue kurta, with tears of gratitude, warm golden morning light.

scenes.narration: उसने अपनी बाकी दौलत से गाँव वालों के लिए घर बनवाए।
scenes.image_prompt: Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman merchant with a mustache and golden yellow turban, standing happily beside villagers building new small brick houses together, bricks and tools, warm golden hour sunlight.

scenes.narration: अब पूरा गाँव उसे दुआएँ देता था, और वो सुकून की नींद सोता था।
scenes.image_prompt: Villagers folding their hands in blessing toward Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman with a mustache and golden turban, who smiles peacefully; a calm village evening with a glowing orange sunset.

scenes.narration: दोस्तों, सोना चमकता है, पर अच्छे कर्म हमेशा साथ रहते हैं।
scenes.image_prompt: A large glowing golden heart shining above a peaceful Indian village at sunset, soft rays of light, with Ramu, a thin stickman with a white cap and blue kurta, and Seth Dhaniram, a chubby stickman with a mustache and golden turban, standing side by side as friends.

scenes.narration: ऐसी कहानियों के लिए फॉलो करना मत भूलिए।
scenes.image_prompt: A big warm golden follow heart and a bell icon glowing softly over a peaceful village at sunset, Ramu and Seth Dhaniram, two stickmen, waving happily at the viewer.
